about_the_game:
Gangs of Asia is a 4 player Multiplayer Action RTS. Players choose from four heros characters with unique micro fighting mechanics and complex emergent Macro strategies.

Take over buildings and generate income to summon six units, including thugs, kung fu masters, sumo wrestlers, and ninjas.

Build your crew, upgrade their skills, and expand your territory by taking over rival turf and strategic locations.

Play Solo VS ai or team up with mates to battle PVP and coop online

LEVEL EDITOR!

Unleash your creativity with the WORK IN PROGRESS custom map editor. Craft your unique battlegrounds, design intricate layouts, and challenge your friends to epic showdowns. With endless possibilities, you can create the ultimate gang warfare experience tailored to your vision.

Key Features:

Four Unique Gang Leaders: Choose from a diverse roster of gang leaders.

Six Unique Unit Types: Summon thugs, kung fu masters, sumo wrestlers, ninjas, and more to build your unstoppable army.


Intense Action RTS Combat: Engage in fast-paced, action-packed battles against rival gangs.


Strategic Base Building: Expand your territory, upgrade your bases, and fortify your defenses.


Diverse Upgrades and Special Attacks: Unlock powerful upgrades and unleash devastating special attacks to dominate your opponents.


Online or Couch Co-op and PVP: Team up with friends for a 4-player Horde mode co-op or battle it out in intense PVP matches.

Horde Mode: Join forces with up to 4 players and defend your turf against relentless waves of enemies in this thrilling cooperative mode.

Custom Map Editor: Create and share your unique maps with the community.
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Gangs of Asia is a work in progress, we would love to add better ai, more maps and a single-player campaign!

Join us on Discord if you want to create maps for a future switch release!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7,8,10,11
  • Processor: Intel Core™ Duo or faster
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 2015+ Graphics card with Open GL 4.0 and above
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core™ Duo or faster
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia 3050 Graphics card or above
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: XInput Gamepad highly recommended.

short_description: Gangs of Asia is a 4-player multiplayer action RTS where you build an army, upgrade recruits, and unleash devastating special attacks. Play solo vs. AI, or team up with mates for online PVP. Experience co-op through shared split-screen, online co-op, or dive into a free-for-all.
